model.prompt: Audio transcription. Language: Arabic. Wording: verbatim, including fillers and repetitions. Formatting: punctuation and capitalization. Output: transcript only.

exposed: per window: the labelled text, its one-edit control and its shifted control, respelled without diacritics (words shared with the model's own transcript take its spelling), plus the model's own transcript; never the label type

rule.pairwise: claimed - alternative >= margin -> match, <= -margin -> mismatch, else unsure; the alternative of the labelled text is its one-edit control and vice versa; shifted is compared with the labelled text
rule.nearBest: claimed >= best - margin -> match, else mismatch; best = the model's own transcript (llm) or greedy CTC path (ctc)
